title.narrative: 4th EU Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP) Seminar with Latin American countries

description.narrative: Contract related to: 4th EU Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP) Seminar with Latin American countries - This action aims to enable the EU to address short and medium-term foreign policy needs and opportunities and to respond to a dynamic and fast-changing foreign policy environment that the EU has been and remains confronted with. Furthermore, it aims to contribute to effective monitoring of the discharge of ALPS-treated water from the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant into the sea.

title.narrative: Global objective (Impact)

description.narrative: Enhanced EU dialogue with South American countries and Mexico on security and defence issues.Raised profile of the EU as an influential actor in the area of security policy and crisis response and management.Security and defence related issues increased in the agenda of EULA biregional relations. In this sense, the identification of common strategic security and defence interests and objectives with partner countries, and the translation of this into support for crisis management and EU policies, would contribute to reaffirming the EUs place and legitimacy as a global security provider.
